entities.name: Query ATP synthase epsilon
observations: 138 aa cyanobacterial-like ATP synthase epsilon chain sequence; exact sequence hash match to UniProt B0JFM8.
Predicted molecular weight is 15,178.139 Da and theoretical pI is 9.044.
Sequence contains ATP-synt_DE_N (PF02823) at residues 3–83 and ATP-synt_DE (PF00401) at residues 86–133.
Likely peripheral component of the chloroplast/cyanobacterial F-type ATP synthase CF1 complex, not a membrane-spanning subunit.

entities.name: B0JFM8 ATP synthase epsilon
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Microcystis aeruginosa with 100% identity and 100% coverage to the query; exact reference sequence hash match.
Annotated as the ATP synthase epsilon chain in the proton-transporting ATP synthase complex.
Annotated localization is thylakoid membrane as a peripheral membrane-associated complex component.
F-type ATP synthase CF1 contains alpha3 beta3 gamma delta epsilon; epsilon is not the catalytic ATP-producing subunit.

entities.name: P26533 ATP synthase epsilon
observations: Reviewed Synechocystis sp. PCC 6803 homolog with 67.6% identity and 98.6% query coverage.
Annotated in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis and the proton-transporting ATP synthase complex.
Reference annotations include ATP-synt_DE_N and ATP-synt_DE epsilon-chain domains; a basic/acidic compositionally biased region is reported in the central-to-C-terminal region.

entities.name: Proton motive force ATP synthesis
observations: ATP synthase epsilon-chain homologs are components of the F-type ATP synthase involved in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis.
